ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $E$ is on the side $BC$ of the rhombus $ABCD$, and $\angle DAE=\angle B=70^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle CDE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rhombus,\\
it follows that $AD\parallel BC$,\\
thus $\angle AEB=\angle DAE=\angle B=70^\circ$,\\
which means $AE=AB=AD$,\\
In $\triangle AED$, $AE=AD$, and $\angle DAE=70^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle ADE=55^\circ$,\\
Also, since $\angle B=70^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle ADC=70^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle CDE=\angle ADC-\angle ADE=15^\circ$.\\
Therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{15^\circ}$

图像描述：图中是一个菱形 ABCD，BC 是底边且近似水平，B 在左下，C 在右下，A 在左上，D 在右上；E 位于边 BC 上，图中画出了线段 AE 和 DE。题目给出 E 在 BC 上，且 ∠DAE = ∠B = 70°。

按指定解析法推理：设菱形边长为 1，取 B=(0,0)，C=(1,0)。因为 ∠B=70°，所以从 B 到 A 的边 BA 与正水平轴成 70°，可取 A=(cos70°, sin70°)。菱形中 AD∥BC 且 AD=1，所以 D=(1+cos70°, sin70°)。设 E=(x,0)。

条件 ∠DAE=70° 表示从 A 出发，AD 沿正水平向右，而 AE 相对 AD 向下成 70°。因此向量 AE=(x−cos70°, −sin70°) 的水平分量满足 x−cos70°=cos70°，所以 x=2cos70°。

从 D 出发，向量 DC=C−D=(−cos70°, −sin70°)，它相对向左的水平线向下倾斜 70°。向量 DE=E−D=(cos70°−1, −sin70°)，它相对向左的水平线向下倾斜角为 arctan(sin70°/(1−cos70°))。由半角恒等式 sin70°/(1−cos70°)=cot35°=tan55°，所以 DE 相对向左水平线向下倾斜 55°。

因此 ∠CDE 是 DC 与 DE 之间的夹角，即 70°−55°=15°。

First describe the figure: The figure shows a slanted rhombus ABCD, with A at the upper left, D at the upper right, B at the lower left, and C at the lower right; point E is on the bottom side BC, and the figure also connects the two line segments AE and DE, with DE located inside angle ADC.

Then reason: Because ABCD is a rhombus, it is also a parallelogram, so AD ∥ BC, and AB = AD. Also because E is on BC, BE and BC are collinear, thus BE ∥ AD.

Given ∠DAE = 70°, since AD ∥ BE, the angle formed by AE and BE, ∠AEB, is also equal to 70°. At the same time, the problem gives ∠B = 70°, and point E is on BC, so ∠ABE = ∠B = 70°. Therefore in △ABE, ∠AEB = ∠ABE, obtaining AE = AB.

Also because in a rhombus AB = AD, so AE = AD. Thus △AED is an isosceles triangle, and the vertex angle ∠DAE = 70°, so the base angle
∠ADE = (180° - 70°) / 2 = 55°.

In addition, opposite angles of a rhombus are equal, so ∠ADC = ∠B = 70°. And DE divides ∠ADC into ∠ADE and ∠CDE, therefore
∠CDE = ∠ADC - ∠ADE = 70° - 55° = 15°.

So the answer is 15°.
